title: Trump’s Attempt to Strangle Iran’s Economy Depends on China’s Cooperation
summary: The U.S. has spent 20 years promising ‘crippling sanctions’ on Iran. But the latest effort comes with a reverse twist, after military action failed to accomplish President Trump’s goals.
